notes.title: Bunny Park Steam Achievements!!
notes.content:
[b]Hello bunny park managers![/b]

As some of you have already noticed, I’ve been working on adding Steam achievements to Bunny Park recently, and I just finished adding 18 new achievements! I hope you’ll enjoy unlocking all of them :)

Additionally, I’ve changed how the seasons work in Bunny Park. I know some people would rather experience them at their own speed, so seasons will now change based on your system’s time. You can keep experiencing real time seasons, or change the date on your system to “time travel” in the game. It's up to you how you want to play Bunny Park!

Here’s a quick recap of the changes:
[list]
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Added Steam Cloud
[*] Changed the game seasonal decorations based on your system’s date
[*] Fixed a bug that caused VR to launch with the game
[*] Increased camera movement speed
[/list]
[b]Take care everyone, I hope you’ll enjoy your time in Bunny Park!
Éloïse[/b]

notes.title: Bunny Park Spring Blossom Update!
notes.content:
[b]Spring is here with a new set of decorations for Bunny Park![/b]
[list]
[*] Grow cherry and orange trees to feed your bunnies!
[*] Adopt ducks and ducklings to keep your bunnies company!
[*] Decorate your park with new items such as a windmill, tulips and a pond!
[/list]
[i]This seasonal event will last until June. However, spring themed decorations placed in the park during this event will stay in your park even once the event is over.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387775/a2c6de803c39d4a57cd43a08560e0d0b3520f610.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bunny Park Winter Wonderland update!
notes.content:
[b]Create your own winter wonderland during this festive event in Bunny Park![/b]
[list]
[*] Add a dozen new winter decorations such as an ice fort, skating rink and festive tree!
[*] Grow winterberry and blueberry bushes!
[*] Give cute winter hats for your bunnies to wear!
[/list]
[i]This seasonal event will last until March. However, winter themed decorations placed in the park during this event will stay in your park even once the event is over.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387775/ddb941930a19423e602647a7222376cc28e4ffc7.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bunny Park Cozy Autumn Update!
notes.content:
[b]Celebrate the fall with cozy autumn themed decorations in Bunny Park![/b]

[*] Add a dozen new fall decorations such as a scarecrow, sunflower & spooky pumpkin!

[/list]
[i]This seasonal even will last until December. However, autumn themed decorations placed in the park during this event will stay in your park even once the event is over.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387775/079ebdf5277e79b25190f422c3decbc0cf1b762a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Celebrate the Summer in Bunny Park!
notes.content:
Bring the summer season to Bunny Park with this cute beach themed update! Additionally, you can get the game for 33% off during the Steam Summer Sale!
[b][list]

[*] Build your park with a dozen new summer themed decorations such as pools, slides & palm trees!
[*] Grow pineapple & pomegranate to feed tropical snacks to your bunnies!
[*] Bunnies will put on their beach hats & sunglasses for the occasion!
[/list][/b]

[i]This seasonal event will last from June 25 to September 21. However, summer themed decorations placed in the park during this event will stay in your park even once the event is over.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387775/655cf2d9c59d19117ef326e08209a255b27206e0.png[/img]

notes.title: Bug fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I've just released a small patch to fix some issues that have been reported since the launch of Bunny Park.
[list]
[*] [b]Improved the butterfly AI[/b]. The butterflies don’t get stuck anymore and fly around faster.
[*] [b]Added mouse camera controls[/b]. Move the camera by bringing your cursor to the edge of the screen. Rotate the camera by holding down the middle mouse button.
[*] [b]Improved game performance.[/b]
[*] [b]Increased the camera movement speed.[/b]
[/list]
Thank you!
